question: Should the applicant receive the workforce training grant?
context: Grant rule G3 funds programs only when at least 70% of participants are in the target group and cost is at most $1,200 per participant. A program that misses either threshold may be redesigned and resubmitted; it must not be approved with an exception.

evidence.text: The proposed course costs $84,000 for 60 participants.
Thirty-nine participants are in the target group; the remaining 21 are not.
A revised cohort can be submitted next month without losing the applicant's place in the program.

fields.name: target_share
fields.description: share of participants in the target group

fields.name: cost_per_person
fields.description: program cost divided by participant count
